name: agentforge
install: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@9.15.9 --activate && pnpm install && pnpm --filter @agentforge/web exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
start: sudo service docker start && docker compose up -d && until docker compose exec -T postgres pg_isready -U agentforge; do sleep 1; done && pnpm db:push
